name: mailchannels/mailchannels-php
description: Official PHP SDK for the MailChannels Email API.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: PSR-18 client and PSR-17 factories in one package. Recommended for most projects; install this OR symfony/http-client, not both.
suggest.symfony/http-client: Alternative PSR-18 client. Pair with nyholm/psr7 for PSR-17 factories. Install this OR guzzlehttp/guzzle, not both.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: Standalone PSR-7 messages and PSR-17 factories. Required if you pick symfony/http-client; optional with guzzlehttp/guzzle.
suggest.symfony/mailer: Required only if you use the Symfony Mailer transport (MailChannelsApiTransport / MailChannelsTransportFactory).
suggest.symfony/webhook: Required only if you use the Symfony webhook processor (MailChannelsPayloadConverter). Requires version 7.2 or higher.
suggest.symfony/remote-event: Required only if you use the Symfony webhook processor (MailChannelsPayloadConverter).
suggest.ext-sodium: Required only if you use the Symfony webhook processor (MailChannelsPayloadConverter). Used for verifying webhook signatures.
suggest.illuminate/mail: Required only if you use the Laravel Mail driver integration (MailChannelsServiceProvider).
